Downtown Anaheim.name: Downtown Anaheim
Downtown Anaheim.description: Center City Promenade mixed-use core with facade grants, adaptive reuse of the 1920s packers corridor, and steady tenant-improvement permitting.

The Colony.name: The Colony
The Colony.description: Historic 1910s-20s residential grid with Craftsman restoration-led permitting and Mills-Act-adjacent churn.

Disneyland Resort & Convention Center.name: Disneyland Resort & Convention Center
Disneyland Resort & Convention Center.description: Theme-park, hotel, and convention anchor with the metro's densest entertainment-adjacent licensing and continuous capital expansion.

Harbor Boulevard Hotel Belt.name: Harbor Boulevard Hotel Belt
Harbor Boulevard Hotel Belt.description: South Harbor motel-to-hotel repositioning strip with Transient-Occupancy-driven renovations and walkable park-gateway demand.

Honda Center & Angel Stadium.name: Honda Center & Angel Stadium
Honda Center & Angel Stadium.description: Platinum Triangle arena-stadium district with high-rise entitlements, ARTIC-adjacent office, and the metro's largest planned-growth pipeline.

West Anaheim Magnolia Belt.name: West Anaheim Magnolia Belt
West Anaheim Magnolia Belt.description: Post-war tract housing along the Magnolia/ Brookhurst retail spine with renovation-led permitting and small-business licensing churn.

Brookhurst Southwest.name: Brookhurst Southwest
Brookhurst Southwest.description: Little Arabia commercial corridor and surrounding garden-apartment stock with restaurant licensing turnover and duplex infill.

Anaheim Canyon Industrial.name: Anaheim Canyon Industrial
Anaheim Canyon Industrial.description: Northeast industrial and food-manufacturing district along the 91 with warehouse conversions, TTM industrial condos, and steady TI permitting.

Nohl Ranch Hills.name: Nohl Ranch Hills
Nohl Ranch Hills.description: Master-planned hillside subdivisions around Nohl Ranch Road with pool/deck auxiliary permits and high-valuation remodel cadence.

Weir Canyon East.name: Weir Canyon East
Weir Canyon East.description: Eastern hillside edge toward Weir and Gypsum canyons with newer single-family stock, solar permitting volume, and wildland-adjacent rebuild cycles.
